g.text: Distributed Tracing: One Request, Four Spans
Real millisecond widths -- the waterfall shows exactly where the 220ms went
Call graph: Client -> Gateway -> Service A -> (Service B, then Service C)
Service B alone is 150ms of the 220ms request -- 68% of the total.
Gateway + Service A's own overhead + Service C combined: 70ms -- everything else is fine.
One trace query answers "where did the time go" -- grepping 3 services' logs by timestamp does not.
